_readme: S631 SkyMayall, 2026-11-10. The 47 Las Positas local degrees name LPC-GE or Cal-GETC with no GE units, and each degree page's 'Additional General Education and Elective Units' figure combines GE with electives (S630, las_positas_ge_units.json), so it cannot stand as ge_units. This read finds the LPC-GE pattern itself (the catalog's Program & General Education Charts) and what it prints for its total units: the articulation page, the college homepage and one local degree page (01001 Administration of Justice A.A.), each following links that name general education or the charts, and printing every such link. No model call.

questions.lpc_ge_units: What total units does the LPC-GE (local associate degree) general education pattern require, and where does the catalog print it?
